decisions.reason: A core upholstery piqué close to the established offer likely still meets aspiration, though it no longer showed on the website in 2024, which raises some doubt.
This low-cost decorative fabric is kept on slack while results stay uncertain, but its weak and fading web presence makes withdrawal at the next collection change quite possible.
A wool-blend double-face fabric with only a minor web mention conflicts with the goal of reducing hard-to-recycle blends, so its resources are better redirected to sustainable development.
This wool leno bouclé fits the renewable-materials direction and the firm's design strength, so it is retained despite modest visibility.
Launched recently with its own product page, it is too early to judge against aspiration and gives no shortfall that calls for search.
